title: French press alliance files antitrust complaint against Google over AI Overviews
reason: Published: fact of the filing (11 Aug 2026 saisine to the Autorite de la concurrence) is confirmed via APIG's own primary statement plus independently-sourced reporting (Journal du Net, not wire-derived) on Google's response. Broad ~15-outlet Google News coverage is largely one AFP wire dispatch (wire-exclusive check applied) and was NOT counted as multiple independent sources. APIG's underlying harm allegations (2022-commitment breach, 33-38% traffic loss citing Arcom) are published strictly attributed to APIG, verdict single-source, never stated as fact, per the Legal/litigation claim-type rule. No ruling yet from the competition authority.
watch: Any statement or procedural update from the Autorite de la concurrence on whether it opens a formal investigation
Independent verification of the 33-38% traffic-loss figure against Arcom's own published data
Google's fuller response or any counter-filing
Whether the July 8 2026 Meta precedent is followed with comparable interim measures against Google

Wire-exclusive check applied per verification.md 2: most aggregated outlets (Euronews byline 'with AFP', MLex brief, likely others) trace to one AFP dispatch; treated as one source.
